summary_md: **PurpleHaze Timetraveler ([@Contrasignal_ai](https://x.com/Contrasignal_ai/status/2115875571464819005))** summarizes **VibeVideoBench** ([arXiv 2610.35864](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35864)): agents get an hour in a sandbox to code a video with sound and no video model; the best system met every core requirement on 76.3% of tasks, and three quarters of missing videos came from renders started too late or running too slow.

referenced_urls.title: VibeVideoBench: Evaluating Multimodal Agents on Code-Driven Video...

relevance: Benchmarks code-driven agentic video production and its time-management failures.
